{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows where either flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g is missing
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Confirm the number of rows after dropping
print(f"Number of rows after dropping missing values: {len(df_clean)}")

# Compute the Pearson correlation
corr = df_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(df_clean['body_mass_g'])
print(f"Pearson correlation: {corr}")"}
